pages.title: Stremio Sync — original centered-panel phone-fitting study

preservedDesign: Original centered dark Stremio panel and scrim, never replaced with a sheet
Official source Stremio SVG, Theme gold/ink/edge palette, Fraunces and Segoe UI
Exact source status headings, explanatory copy, account/last-sync metadata and result slot
Source switch/disconnect confirmations and primary/secondary button presentation
Original Close/Cancel, busy/paused/unavailable disabled states, Escape and keyboard-button focus
Source-derived Connections background with original Stremio Open settings route
Original alpha's phone-sized header close button and action flow retained on phones
fittingChanges: 620px width cap plus viewport-side clamping, 440/470px height cap plus vertical clamping
Phone uses original 12px outer/inner spacing, 16px radius, 30px icon, 22px heading and 48px buttons
Wrap existing action buttons and long dynamic data instead of replacing controls
Retain centered panel while scrolling original content and revealing focused action
Edit viewport dimensions, insets, font scale, fixture status and IME preview only in outer review controls
Noninteractive, clearly labelled simulated IME mask reserved outside app content
unresolved: OnePlus viewport, DPR, real safe-area values, native font scaling and keyboard rectangle have not been measured
Exact QML FocusRing, Qt ScrollBar, real account-status and native IME suppression not runtime-tested
Connections background is source-derived representative context, not complete QML pixel parity
At 792x354 with hypothetical 260px keyboard and 24px top/bottom insets, 46px remains: a full 48px phone action cannot fit; checked keyboard-landscape uses explicit 140px reserve
Real Colosseum implementation, Android install, beta and publication intentionally untouched

verification.method: Installed Puppeteer + Google Chrome, isolated headless browser contexts and disposable profile; temporary loopback HTTP server rooted at batch directory
verification.panelBoundsAndClipping: All checked cases pass safe/IME bounds and no horizontal overflow
verification.touchTargetReachability: All checked original actions can be scrolled into view with at least 42px button height; phone actions use 48px
verification.fontsLoaded: FrauncesMock and SegoeMock loaded from existing local reference assets in every tested case
verification.externalNetwork: No external requests; only localhost serving batch-root assets
verification.interactions: Switch → Cancel → Disconnect → Connect → Close → Reopen exercised in HTML fixture; no provider calls
verification.alternativeRenderer: BDC render_html returned HTML_RENDER_OUTPUT_MISSING; not relied on. Captures and audit were produced by standalone Puppeteer/Chrome.
verification.evidenceLevel: Authored and headless-browser-rendered/tested HTML mock; NOT QML runtime, native Android or device validated
